title: Lewis Black at Epstein's mansion and the Israeli defense minister
summary: Kurt Metzger tells of Lewis Black at Epstein's mansion and the Israeli defense minister, about unspecified at Epstein's mansion, New York, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:

plain: A comedian, Kurt Metzger, retells a story he says comes from another comedian, Lewis Black, by way of a third, Bobby Slayton, about a visit to the New York mansion of the financier Jeffrey Epstein. In Metzger's telling, Black walked in and saw a marker board covered in what looked like football plays, and the story goes on to involve Israel's defence minister. Metzger tells it as a hint of what was really going on behind Epstein's doors.
